title: (Pwn2Own) Lexmark CX532adwe getCFFNames Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Lexmark CX532adwe printers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getCFFNames function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the pagemaker user.
